verification.method: Minify the official ES module, resolve lexical symbols with TypeScript, normalize local bindings and redundant parentheses around function expressions, then compare the entire printed AST including exports.

scope: The offline Deno test harness derives a temporary import map from the current manifest and maps only the unstable tslib URL to the unchanged official ES module. The generator verifies its SHA-256. Production imports, Deno manifest and lock remain unchanged; every other remote module uses the original frozen lock.
